_comment: How the judge CREATES the data conditions a design state needs, instead of reporting it unmeasurable. Each driver captures the live data, forces the condition, lets the judge measure, then restores. Keyed by SDK element facade + API names taken from the manifest, so a driver holds for any design built on that family — never a per-design script.

drivers.describes: what a collection surface shows when it holds no items (empty state, zero-data illustration, first-run hint)
drivers.mutation: delete every annotation; the empty surface must lay out with a real box
